name: Dangsin-eul Gidarineun Yeou Hwa
source:
The sequel to the novel game "The Fox is Waiting for Me'', is finally here!

The story revolves around Shua, a slightly naughty fox girl who lives in a fox mansion deep in the forest, and Kaito, a boy with amnesia, and Mimir, a mountain god with a small body but big attitude who lives in a nearby lake.

One day, Lyufa and Renfa were dispatched by the Shua clan to test her power. Starting with the encounter between Shua and Ryufa, Kaito and his friends become entangled in the plans of the Shinigami and the Fox Clan.

Will Kaito, who got lost with Ryufa in a space-time that closed due to a certain trigger, be able to escape safely? And what is the aim of Karin's "senior'' who is working behind the scenes?

The bond between Kaito, Shua, Mimir, and Karin will be tested!

[from [url=https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/switch/354899-the-fox-awaits-me-hana]Gamefaqs[/url]]
translation:
小说游戏《狐狸在等我》续作终于来了！

故事围绕住在森林深处的狐狸府里的略调皮的狐女舒亚、失忆的男孩海斗和住在附近湖边身材娇小但态度大的山神米米尔展开。

有一天，修亚族派遣柳法和仁法来测试她的力量。从修亚和龙发的相遇开始，快斗和他的朋友们就被死神和狐族的计划所纠缠。

与龙发一起迷失在因某种触发而关闭的时空中的海斗能否安全逃脱呢？而卡琳的幕后“前辈”又有何目的呢？

Kaito、Shua、Mimir和Karin之间的羁绊将受到考验！

[来自[url=https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/switch/354899-the-fox-awaits-me-hana]Gamefaqs[/url]]
